objective: Improve the native range bot against Slumbot; six-seat checks guard against regressions. No persona work.

control.replacement_reason: First long process terminated externally before final summary; excluded from confirmatory comparison.

development: Three successive candidates: more stable equity; public bet-size/re-raise likelihoods; preflop or action-selection repair based on evidence. Local duplicate-deal screens plus 3000 live hands per candidate. Development scores are exploratory.
holdout: After all development attempts, select once; compare a fresh 6000-hand candidate run with the first 6000 completed control hands from slumbot_confirm_control.jsonl. Prefix verified free of interrupted attempts and fixed before its prefix score was computed. Full source plus unused suffix retained. Fresh local seed.
concurrency: Five games per process; frozen control may overlap one development candidate, at most ten games total. Candidates run sequentially. Updated before development outcomes because observed HTTP throughput is about 9 hands/s. Retain unresolved attempts.
cleanup: One active range policy with a sample-budget setting; retain Fullhouse and one original rules control. Remove superseded variants from active source/API; full frozen source snapshots and old libraries retain historical reproductions. Stable IDs 1/4/7 are not renumbered.
fourth_candidate: Exact HU river enumeration, branched from original range model; local screen, independent exhaustive oracle, and 3000 Slumbot development hands before selection. Added after first development run, before its own outcomes.
fourth_candidate_retry: DNS recovered. Run a new independent 3000-hand river development series, seed 2026101826; exclude interrupted 610-hand attempt from selection.
